lines: The message in my clenched hand, that's rising hope
An unshakable world, a merciless reality—how many layers do these walls go on?
Nothing like the picture I had in mind; my instincts have quietly started to stir
It's like a maze, a dead end—my thoughts are already distortion
Merciless, isn't it? Somewhere along the way the route I lost has started to run wild
(Watch your step now!) I don't need common sense
The rhythm of my heart comes back to life
My vision's still blurred, but I have to go anyway
I can't betray the me you believe in—the horn blares loud and strong
Even if time passes while I stay alone, even if I learn to run away
A new today will come anyway (I believe in anymore)
I swore I'd make this wish come true even if there's no magic
There's a future I still want to see, together with you (I seen my hope)
Even if I'm about to cry, even if it hurts, I can't stop here
The message in my clenched hand, that's rising hope
But still, non stop, the hard way bears down on me full force
(Where's the solution?) Even when it knocks me flat
Get up! (Come on!) And hurry up! (Come on!)
Time that wasted like that goes straight into the trash
Regret is nothing but dust—come on, two step, OK, shouting, OK, be as greedy as you like
Yes or no, for or against, it's all mine—rev it up, algorithm of my heart
See, I really do want to protect it—my voice has carried
I'll allow objections and counterarguments, but this longing isn't something you could carelessly reduce to science, is it?
Listen—I've reached the right answer, I have to say it
I can keep believing in everything of the longing you give me
Whether that's a lie or not, it's fine not to know
What was that model someone held up again? What was ordinary love again?
Today too, I ask myself
And every time I ask, what I gain is the unchanging truth
"I'm not needed—because there's a future I still want to see"
Let loneliness vanish and disappear; let me come to hate running away
I'm searching for a new today (I believe in anymore)
I swore I'd make this wish come true even if there's no magic
A future the two of us can build is already close (I seen my hope)
My right hand and your left hand, gently joined
The message in my clenched hand, that's rising hope
I won't let go, that's rising hope
Rising hope...
